root.label: Search continues for two crew after French fishing boat sinks

events.label: Search continues for two crew after French fishing boat sinks

slots.name: missing crew
slots.sentence: A large number of civilian vessels are assisting the "intensive search" for the two remaining crew members, an HM Coastguard spokesperson added.

slots.name: rescued people
slots.sentence: HM Coastguard in Falmouth said three people were rescued from the boat and have been taken to hospital.

slots.name: lifeboats deployed
slots.sentence: A coastguard rescue helicopter, fixed-wing plane and two RNLI lifeboats began searching an area south-west of Eddystone Lighthouse off Plymouth after the crew released a distress call at 18:00 BST on Saturday.
